believed: Standing on a station platform in the rain, holding a ticket they did not buy.
A kitchen with yellow curtains, and someone singing badly in the next room.
Shaking hands with a man whose face they can no longer assemble.
The exact weight of a coffin handle in their palm.
A telegram on a hall table: COME AT ONCE. ALL IS FORGIVEN.
Locking a door from the outside and walking away quickly.
The smell of carbolic soap and someone counting backwards from ten.
A promise made at a bedside, in a whisper, meant to be kept.

contradicting: They remember the fire at the mill — and that they were the only survivor. So does someone else here.
They remember growing up an only child. One of the others remembers being their sibling.
They remember this exact conversation happening before, word for word, aboard this train.
